lines: Me
Daaaamn it!! How did I get into this mess!?
I was running through the black market district that I was supposed to be enjoying.
Somehow I had broken through them, but more and more pursuers appeared and came after me.
Me
Shit, those damn brats...!! I'll make them pay for this if I ever see them again...!!!
Then another attacker appeared out of an alley ahead.
Orc
Found him! That's the chief of those kids!!
Male Demon
Apparently he's the leader controlling the kids in this area, so don't let you guard down!!!
Me
(Did they surround me?! And this tale is getting even taller!!)
I quickly tried to return the way I had come from, butー
Voice of an attacker
Stop right thereー!!!
Me
Shit!! Over here too!!!
I was blocked in on both sides and tried to hide in the entrance of a building close to me for the time being.
The black market district, which was supposed to have been fun, had completely turned into an ordeal I might not escape from with my life. And this was all because of those damn demon kids.
Me
...What do I do?! There's no way I can beat all of them...!!!
At that moment, the door behind me suddenly opened.
And then a pale hand grabbed my armー
This way!!
Me
Eh!?
*Slam*ー
...And I was dragged into the building.
Me
A soft carpet cushioned my body as I fell down from being pulled suddenly.
A chandelier was glittering above me and ambient music was playing. It seemed like a high-class club.
Me
Wh-Who are you...!?
Shizuru
Just follow me.
From her appearance, the woman seemed to be a hostess of this club. But why did she help me? What if she was an accomplice of my pursuers...?
Me
(No, if she was one of them, she would've attacked me immediately.)
In any case, I'd be dead if I went outside.
Me
(Haaahh, nothing to do except trust this goddess for now...!)
I followed the woman while stumbling over the fluffy carpet.
